items.title: Live: India back at Rs 5 lakh crore market; rupee up 3% from record lows | Closing Bell
items.description: Markets stage a monstrous rally, extending their winning streak to a sixth consecutive session, as the Republican sweep in the US cheers bulls on Dalal Street. The Nifty has surged 1,500 points so far this week, while the Sensex has soared 5,000 points. The Nifty reclaims the 24,550 mark, gaining nearly 2,000 points from the day’s low, while market breadth remains firmly in favour of advances. Auto, metal and banking stocks drive the rally, while energy stocks lag and media stocks decline. Oil prices retreat slightly following a sharp 9% overnight drop. US futures trade mixed after the stellar rally on Wall Street. Among Nifty 50 stocks, Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance and IndiGo are the top gainers, while Apollo Hospitals, ONGC and NTPC are the top losers.

items.title: Harendra Kumar On Why India Will Be The Biggest AI Trade | Samvat 2083
items.description:
In this Diwali special episode of Markets Over Coffee, our guest is Harendra Kumar, MD & CEO of Elara Securities. He went from journalist to capital markets veteran and has over 25 years of experience. In this conversation, we find out why he stays bullish on India even when market sentiment is weak.

In this episode you’ll learn:

Why earnings growth lagged over the last two years, and when it could recover
Why mid and small caps should be played with the cycle rather than bought and held
How to think about asset allocation between large caps and SMID
His framework for using the rupee as a gauge in the new Samvat, and his view on SIPs
India’s AI trade: data centres, financiers, power and capital goods
Why to watch the order book to decide when to book profits in capital goods stocks
How fintechs and NBFCs can cut costs with AI
Will AI take away jobs?
FTAs, export themes and auto ancillaries
Investing in global stocks, Pre-IPOs, SIFs and rising volatility
Advice for young finance professionals

items.title: Samir Arora: Is India's Negative Halo Reversing? His Nifty Call, FPI Outlook & Top Stock Bets
items.description:
Is India's negative halo finally beginning to reverse? After a prolonged phase of foreign investor selling and market underperformance, are global investors ready to look at India again?

In this special edition of The Wealth Formula with N Mahalakshmi, veteran investor Samir Arora makes the bullish case for Indian markets and explains how he is reading the latest FPI flows, the Nasdaq correction and the global rotation into AI stocks.
